name: Union With Christ
overview: Union with Christ is a profound spiritual reality where believers are intimately joined to Him, as expressed in John 6:56 and John 14:20, where Christ dwells in us and we in Him. This union signifies mutual belonging and abiding, much like the mutual love described in Song of Solomon 2:16 and 7:10. It also carries practical implications for Christian living, as seen in Matthew 25:40 and 25:45, where acts toward others are understood as acts toward Christ Himself.
